title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-29
lineage: AUD > ?? > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: An exceptional audience recording of the Carousel with a soaring New Potato Caboose and powerful Morning Dew, though some listeners note uneven moments.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as one of the best audience recordings of 1968, delivering clear, surprisingly full‑band sound that even rivals many early soundboards. Musically the show shines on Morning Dew, New Potato Caboose and a solid Other One suite, while tracks like Lovelight and the truncated Born Cross‑Eyed draw criticism. Overall the performance is energetic but a few listeners feel it lacks the momentum of adjacent shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ~4.3 across 18 reviews, with consistent praise for audio quality and New Potato performance offset by occasional criticisms of song flow and recording quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Widely described as the best 1968 audience tape, crisp for its era with good instrument separation; some note echo, Phil's bass a bit low in mix, and missing portions of Lovelight and Born Cross‑Eyed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Morning Dew, a dip in momentum after the Quick/Dead tour segment, then a high point at New Potato Caboose; overall pacing is solid but some feel the first set outshines the second.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar praised for sustained, howling notes and superb tone, especially on New Potato.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as deep and powerful by some, though a few note it sits low in the mix.
